title: Motion tween: interpolate color effect (tint/brightness/alpha/advanced) across keyframes
description:
Flash 8 motion tweens interpolate not just position/scale/rotation/alpha but also color effects (tint, brightness, advanced color transform) on symbol instances. The current TweenTarget type (packages/core/src/tween/types.ts) only has {x, y, scaleX, scaleY, rotation, alpha} — tint color and brightness are absent.

Current behavior: if you put a red-tinted instance on frame 1 and a blue-tinted instance on frame 20 with a motion tween, the tween snaps between the two tints instead of interpolating the RGB components. Only alpha animates through the tween (because it's in TweenTarget).

Scope:
1. Extend TweenTarget to include colorEffect: ColorEffect | null (matching the ColorEffect type in engine/types.ts — brightness, tint, alpha, advanced).
2. In interpolateTween (packages/core/src/tween/interpolate.ts) add interpolation for each color effect variant:
   - alpha: lerp the alpha percentage
   - tint: lerp tintPercent + lerp R/G/B of tintColor
   - brightness: lerp brightness
   - advanced: lerp each of the 8 multiplier/offset components
3. In displayObjectToTweenTarget (packages/core/src/model/timeline-query.ts) extract colorEffect from SymbolInstance.
4. In the tween result reconstruction, apply the interpolated colorEffect back to the SymbolInstance.
5. In the SWF compiler (packages/swf/src/compile.ts), emit CXFormWithAlpha from the interpolated colorEffect at each motion-tweened frame — currently it only emits a static CXForm from the keyframe's colorEffect (line ~1167).

Acceptance: a 2-keyframe motion tween between a tinted (red 50%) instance and an untinted instance shows smooth color fade in both the authoring canvas and the published SWF in Ruffle.
